e2209b1ae73c5537.title: Monthly Rent Stabilization Workshops
e2209b1ae73c5537.desc: The Rent Stabilization Department is pleased to announce the return of its Monthly Workshops on Rent Stabilization Topics for 2026. Whether you're a tenant, landlord, or community member, these workshops provide the tools and knowledge needed to confidently navigate Pasadena’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance. Each session will be led by Helen Morales, Director of the Rent Stabilization Department, along with department staff, who will share expert insights and answer questions from the community. Workshops will be held on the second Tuesday of each month at 6:00 p.m. at the Los Robles Building (199 S. Los Robles Ave., 1st Floor Conference Room). Residents may attend in person or participate virtually via Zoom at Bit.ly/MonthlyRSDWorkshops . 2026 Workshop Schedule: March 10: Understanding the Ellis Act April 14: Habitability & Downward Adjustments of Rent May 12: Hearings & Petitions for Rent Increases June 9: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) Overview July 14: Just Cause Protections August 11: Rent Rollback and Rent Increases September 8: Annual Rental Registration October 13: Security Deposits
